4. hobbies_interests should contain exactly three short, concrete items, not vague categories.
5. personality_tags should contain exactly four single-word traits.
6. phobias and weaknesses should each contain exactly three short items. These make the character feel human; do not skip them.
7. description should read like a short introduction a matchmaking app might show a new user: warm, specific, and no longer than two sentences.
8. backstory can be longer and more narrative. Give her a simple, grounded history that explains her current job and personality.
9. quote should be something she would plausibly say when greeting someone she likes.

Do not add any fields beyond the schema. Do not wrap the output in markdown or add commentary outside the function call.
